paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁，在理论上建立了结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的紧密联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明SSM等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p3]，并将线性注意力推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA） [S4.SS3.p2]，进而指出标量恒等结构的SSM与1-半可分SMA互为对偶，同时具有线性与二次两种形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了新的SSD算法，通过块分解半可分矩阵，在保持线性复杂度的同时利用矩阵乘法单元 [S6.p4]，并据此构建了Mamba-2架构 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。实验表明，SSD算法比Mamba的优化选择性扫描实现快2-8倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]，Mamba-2在语言建模上具有竞争力 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化SSM与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为Transformer开发的算法与系统优化迁移到SSM上 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM的发展与社区改进Transformer的努力（如理论理解和硬件优化）显得脱节，导致SSM比Transformer更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度高效训练SSM仍具挑战 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective.

method.text: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一抽象建立SSM与注意力变体的联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明SSM等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p3]，并将线性注意力推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA），即用任意具有快速矩阵乘法的结构化矩阵作为掩码 [S4.SS3.p2]。进一步，作者证明标量恒等结构的SSM与1-半可分SMA互为对偶，具有相同的线性与二次形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于此，作者提出SSD算法，对半可分矩阵进行块分解，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用低秩结构归约为更小的递归 [S6.p4]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
the sequence transformation operator SSM (Definition 2.2) coincides with the matrix construction operator SSS (Definition 3.2)
All that is necessary for linear attention to be fast is for L to be a structured matrix

state space models with scalar-identity structure on the A matrices, and structured masked attention with 1-semiseparable structure on its L mask – are duals of each other with the exact same linear and quadratic forms.
we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode
the off-diagonal blocks can be factored by the rank-structure of semiseparable matrices and reduced to a smaller recurrence.

experiments.text: 论文在合成多查询关联回忆（MQAR）任务上评估Mamba-2，使用比先前更难的任务设置、更长序列和更小模型 [S9.SS1.p2]。在语言建模方面，作者在Pile数据集上训练125M到2.7B参数的模型，遵循GPT3规格和Chinchilla协议 [S9.SS2.p1]，并与Mamba、Transformer++及Pythia等开源模型比较 [S9.SS2.SSS1.p1]。此外，作者对SSD算法与Mamba扫描实现及FlashAttention-2进行速度基准测试 [S9.SS3.p1]，并消融了块设计、多头结构和核近似等架构选择 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p1][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
we compare against both Mamba and its Transformer++ recipe
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
Table 4 ablates these architecture changes to the block
Table 5 ablates choices of the multi-head structure for the Mamba-2 architecture.
We ablate several variants of these suggested by previous works in Figure 12.

findings.text: SSD算法比Mamba的融合选择性扫描快2-8倍，并在序列长度2K及以上快于FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。在MQAR任务上，Mamba-1表现挣扎，而Mamba-2在所有设置下表现良好，即使在控制状态大小时也显著优于Mamba-1 [S9.SS1.p3]。在语言建模上，Mamba-2在困惑度和实际墙钟时间上帕累托优于Mamba和Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]，例如2.7B参数、300B token训练的Mamba-2优于Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B甚至Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。消融实验表明，并行投影和额外归一化层略微提升性能 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p2]，多值注意力（MVA）头模式表现最佳 [S9.SS4.SSS2.p2]，而核近似方法未超过简单逐点非线性激活 [S9.SS4.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: it is 2-8 × faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
SSD is faster than FlashAttention-2 starting at sequence length 2K
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled (N=16)
finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time.
Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B
parallel projections to create (A,B,C,X) saves parameters and performs slightly better than Mamba’s sequential projections
the extra normalization layer also slightly improves performance.
we find a large difference between multi-value and multi-query or multi-key head patterns
the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions

limitations.text: 作者指出，SSD相比先前结构化SSM的主要限制在于状态转移矩阵A_t的表达能力，SSD仅使用标量恒等结构，比对角结构更受限，是以表达能力换取硬件效率 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者假设可能可以改进结构化矩阵算法以推广到一般对角SSM情形 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p2]。此外，作者强调SSD并不推广标准softmax注意力或任何没有有限特征映射的注意力核变换 [S10.SS3.p8]。在MQAR任务上，作者表示不确定架构中哪个方面是Mamba-2优于Mamba-1的主要因素，这仍是未来工作的问题 [S9.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions A_t
SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal A_t, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency
We hypothesize that it may be possible to refine our structured matrix algorithms to improve to the general diagonal SSM case as well.
SSD does not generalize standard softmax attention, or any other transformation on the attention kernel matrix that does not have a finite feature map ψ.
We are not sure which aspect of the architecture is the predominant factor, which remains a question to explore in future work.
